title: Biological Safety Cabinet Field Certification Record
description: Evidence model for annual field certification of Biological Safety Cabinets (BSC) used in BSL-2/3 laboratory work — HEPA integrity (PAO/DOP challenge), face velocity, and airflow smoke-pattern verification. Equipment-level performance record distinct from facility-level LMO containment and from bench-level aerosol work-practice controls.

face_velocity_fpm.description: Measured intake face velocity (feet per minute) at the work opening.

hepa_integrity_passed.description: True if the downstream PAO/DOP challenge scan detected no penetration above 0.01%.
